title: My City
text:
I live in a big city by the sea. There is a tall tower in the centre of the city. In summer, many tourists visit the beaches. The sea is blue and warm.

The city has a famous market. People buy fruit, bread and fish there. In winter, the streets are quiet and the weather is cold. Many people like to read in cafés.

questions.text: What do people buy at the market?
When is the city most likely to be busy with visitors?
Why are the streets quiet in winter?
options: Because the weather is cold and fewer people go out
Because the market is open all day

vocabulary.definition: the middle part of a place
people who travel to visit other places
a place where people buy and sell goods

paragraph_translations: Büyük bir deniz kenti Yaşıyorum. Şehrin merkezinde uzun bir kule var. Yazın birçok turist plajları ziyaret ediyor. Deniz mavi ve sıcak.
Şehirde ünlü bir pazar var. İnsanlar orada meyve, ekmek ve balık satın alıyor. Kışın sokaklar sessiz ve hava soğuk olur. Birçok insan kafelerde kitap okumayı sever.
